Commentary: Extra cover moves straighter
Liam Dawson to Dasun Shanaka, SIX, poor delivery and duly punished! A juicy full-toss around off, Shanaka says thank you very much and clubs it over deep mid-wicket for a biggie
Liam Dawson to Dasun Shanaka, THATS OUT!! Caught!!

Liam Dawson to Dasun Shanaka, out Caught by Jos Buttler!! Dawson has his revenge! Shanaka can't quite believe it. A short delivery wide outside off, keeps a bit low, Shanaka reaches out and tries to cut it square of the wicket but only manages to get an under-edge. Jos Buttler behind the stumps takes a sharp catch. England continue to chip away at the wickets. Dasun Shanaka c Jos Buttler b Liam Dawson 12(13) [6s-1]

Jamie Overton to Kamindu Mendis, SIX, crunched! A shortish delivery on off that sits up nicely for Mendis. He stands tall, gets on top of the bounce and pulls it with authority over deep mid-wicket for a maximum

Jofra Archer to Kamindu Mendis, out Caught by Will Jacks!! The set batter departs! The visitors continue to slip! A shortish delivery outside off, Mendis goes for the pull across the line but only manages to get it off the toe-end. Will Jacks is standing well in at deep mid-wicket from the boundary ropes. He positions himself and takes it safely. Good field placement from Brook. Kamindu Mendis c Will Jacks b Jofra Archer 35(28) [4s-3 6s-2]
